purpose: Deterministic directory-only candidate selection for the future bounded MRF pilot and expansion intake. This is a frozen input proposal, not endpoint evidence, TiC qualification, scientific approval, or a production cohort.

dependency_context.dependency_use: Recorded for provenance only; no repository files are changed by this preparation.

hospital.source_role: CMS Hospital General Information public directory; facility identity, place, hospital type, and hospital ownership only.
hospital.excluded_fields_and_reason: Ratings, quality measures, phone numbers, and any payload/endpoint fields are not used.

payer.source_role: CMS PY2026 Final QIS Issuer List public directory; HIOS issuer identity/legal name/state and QIS flags.
directory_only_fields: Required to Submit Implementation Plan Form
Required to Submit Progress Report Form
Number of Progress Report Submissions Required
payer.qis_limitation: QIS workbook membership is retained as source metadata and is not a Transparency in Coverage reporting-entity or file-binding determination.

normalization_and_identity.raw_values: Retain exact source strings in fixtures. Selection uses stripped strings for required-field and duplicate checks only.
normalization_and_identity.hospital_id: Preserve Facility ID as a string, require six ASCII digits, and require uniqueness across directory_rows.
normalization_and_identity.hospital_state: Preserve source State, require exactly two uppercase ASCII letters, and treat every source code as a jurisdiction category without manual endpoint-based exclusions.
normalization_and_identity.hospital_ownership: Use exact stripped Hospital Ownership value as the ownership category; do not infer parent systems, mergers, control, or legal equivalence.
normalization_and_identity.payer_hios_id: Preserve HIOS Issuer ID as a string, require five ASCII digits, and require uniqueness across directory_rows.
normalization_and_identity.payer_state: Preserve source State, require exactly two uppercase ASCII letters.
normalization_and_identity.payer_legal_name: Retain exact source legal name. For duplicate screening only, compare stripped case-folded names; do not infer parent-company sameness from text.

seed_and_tiebreak.final_tiebreak: Lower lowercase hexadecimal tie hash, then lower source ID, wins. No input order or name familiarity is used as an implicit tie-break.

directory_eligibility: All six projection fields are present and non-empty after stripping.
Facility ID matches ^[0-9]{6}$ and is unique.
No endpoint, MRF, price, quality, rating, or performance result is read or considered.
priority_order: Maximize a newly represented State code; this produces 25 distinct source jurisdictions when at least 25 are eligible.
Among new-state candidates, maximize a newly represented exact Hospital Ownership category.
Prefer lower current State frequency, then lower current ownership frequency.
Break remaining ties by the seeded SHA-256 tie hash and Facility ID.
hospital_selection.per_round_sort_key: (-new_state, -new_ownership, current_state_count, current_ownership_count, tie_hash, Facility ID), ascending
hospital_selection.selection_rule: Repeat the per-round sort over unselected eligible rows until 25 rows are frozen; never replace a frozen row because a later endpoint or eligibility observation is unfavorable.
hospital_selection.diversity_policy: State/jurisdiction spread is the hard first priority; ownership spread is a deterministic secondary priority. The output reports achieved distinct counts for root adjudication.

directory_eligibility: HIOS Issuer ID, Issuer Legal Name, and State are present and non-empty after stripping.
HIOS Issuer ID matches ^[0-9]{5}$ and is unique.
All QIS columns are retained as raw directory metadata; QIS membership is not used as TiC qualification.
No endpoint, MRF, price, provider-reference, or reporting-file result is read or considered.
priority_order: Maximize a newly represented State code; this produces 10 distinct source jurisdictions when at least 10 are eligible.
Among new-state candidates, maximize a newly represented exact stripped case-folded legal name.
Prefer lower current State frequency, then lower current exact-name frequency.
Break remaining ties by the seeded SHA-256 tie hash and HIOS Issuer ID.
payer_selection.per_round_sort_key: (-new_state, -new_legal_name, current_state_count, current_legal_name_count, tie_hash, HIOS Issuer ID), ascending
payer_selection.selection_rule: Repeat the per-round sort over unselected eligible rows until 10 rows are frozen; preserve every selected HIOS ID if later unavailable or ineligible and do not substitute.
payer_selection.diversity_policy: State spread and distinct authoritative legal names/HIOS IDs are the directory-only goals. Text similarity is not used to merge issuers or claim ten qualified TiC reporting entities.

frozen_output_contract.substitution_policy: No substitutions after this candidate set is frozen. PR-046 and PR-049 consume IDs only after independent source/file eligibility checks.
frozen_output_contract.missing_family_mapping: Twelve missing source families remain a separate bounded intake mapping task; this directory-only selection package does not invent family membership or endpoint support.
